messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: parameters estimates correlation matrix
parts: I think with the use of 'lavinspect' function and 'vcov.std.all' option in it. you can reach to the correlation matrix between parameters estimates.

That option still provides an asymptotic covariance matrix, but among the standardized parameters.  To get the correlation matrix of the unstandardized parameters, just transform the covariance matrix using the cov2cor() utility.

example(cfa)
cov2cor(vcov(fit))
